title: Global Inflation Surges Driven by Oil as RBI Triggers Durable Liquidity Absorption
changed: US CPI reaching 3.4% alongside Brent crude touching $105 per barrel pushed market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike to 90%. North American trade friction escalated as the US imposed import bans on Canadian goods, bolstering safe-haven demand for the US dollar. UK GDP expanded 0.4% in July on AI services growth, while ECB guidance maintained cautious inflation monitoring, holding global sovereign bond yields at elevated baselines.

Domestically, monetary conditions shifted toward aggressive tightening as the RBI announced a ₹1 lakh crore Open Market Operation (OMO) bond sale to drain long-term liquidity. This follows daily VRRR absorptions throughout the week ranging from ₹3.44 lakh crore to ₹4.61 lakh crore at a 5.24% cut-off. Short-term rates responded rapidly, with overnight call money holding between 4.98% and 4.99%, 364-day T-bills setting yields at 5.91%, and the 2033 benchmark G-sec yield establishing at 6.81% ahead of a ₹35,900 crore state debt issuance pipeline.

Foreign portfolio investment faces headwinds from widening US-India rate differentials, compounding the Nifty's 8.6% YTD decline driven by capital allocation shifts toward North Asian semiconductor equities. SEBI finalized a formal pact with ESMA to preserve European bank access to Indian clearing houses, while simultaneously easing operational compliance for FPIs trading exclusively in Indian sovereign paper. Tata Motors assumed full operational restructuring responsibility for Jaguar Land Rover after the UK government ruled out state bridge aid.

For tax and audit practices, statutory clarity on GST rate rationalisation and corporate guarantee valuations remains deferred until the October 7 GST Council meeting. RBI issued updated Priority Sector Lending classification rules and streamlined legacy FEMA circulars governing non-resident accounts and vostro balance reconciliations. Additionally, SEBI released operational FAQs for its Demat 2.0 corporate bond tokenisation pilot and enforced updated penalty frameworks for commodity derivative position limits.

threads.name: US Hawkish Repricing and Fed Rate Odds
threads.note: US CPI at 3.4% and crude at $105 per barrel drove market pricing for a Fed hike to 90%. A pullback in crude energy prices or softer inflation metrics breaks this trajectory.

threads.name: RBI Liquidity Drain and Sovereign Yield Pressure
threads.note: The RBI's planned ₹1 lakh crore OMO bond sale and ₹5 lakh crore overnight VRRR auction act to absorb surplus cash and lift G-sec yields. Strong institutional demand for state paper and primary sovereign auctions prevents further spread widening.

threads.name: FPI Flow Pressures on Domestic Assets
threads.note: Foreign rotation out of Indian equities toward North Asian hardware suppliers drove an 8.6% YTD drop in the Nifty. SEBI's compliance relief for sovereign-only FPIs aims to buffer debt inflows against dollar index strength.

threads.name: Regulatory and FEMA Compliance Overhauls
threads.note: RBI's FEMA circular rationalisation and revised non-resident account rules require immediate audit updates for bank vostro accounts. Deferral of the GST Council meeting to October 7 delays tax planning for corporate clients.
